set.body:
Outcome: ScalaFIM focuses on functional neuroimaging. MVPA lives in ../mvpa4s; neuro-surface semantics and display live in ../neurosurf4s, consuming ../mesh4s. Generic capabilities have one owner in the existing core libraries. Prioritize clean boundaries and DRY over preserving duplicate pre-1.0 facades.

Design and source inventory: docs/plans/ecosystem-unification.md (baseline 86b3acf1e64d762be99b52ae146fa115b9050356). This epic is the execution breakdown, not a second architecture specification.

Shared acceptance for every implementation task:
- Migrate known callers and delete the replaced implementation at each cutover; do not leave a permanent parallel route.
- Providers and extracted libraries have no ScalaFIM dependency, including test sources. Keep JVM/JS and optional integration dependencies explicit.
- Preserve ordering, identity, provenance, persisted schemas/digest framing, scientific behavior and scoped/allocation contracts. Package moves do not imply wire-format changes.
- Run affected portable tests on JVM and JS; keep JavaFX JVM-only and Three.js JS-only. Retain existing caveats and failed evidence. Record revisions and actual check outcomes.

Epic acceptance:
- U0-U6 gates satisfied; one domain, frame, topology and provenance authority per concern.
- Standalone mvpa4s and neurosurf4s consumers pass without ScalaFIM or sibling overrides.
- ScalaFIM workflows consume pinned extracted providers; no implementation copies or forbidden dependency edges remain.
- README, module map, builds and CI describe the resulting graph. Publication is separate from implementation acceptance.

Scheduling: identity -> MVPA and coordinates -> mesh -> neuro-surface are separate paths. Only the MVPA surface adapter waits for both. Milestone parent relations organize work; dependency edges alone block it. Leave tasks unassigned until implementation begins.

Reconcile existing native-image, unified-MVPA, spatial-transform and mesh-integration work during U0; reuse completed evidence rather than recreating it. References: bd-01KYNR99SWCFEW94T4JGD9QPBS, bd-01M2BMGRP4MSM0RRRKNTHM0H4K, bd-01M39Q2YNKRTJTD8PZ4694DS52, bd-01KYT2FD73TC4X1SC10HB5NCW3. Their current status was unavailable during preparation.
set.title: Unify core providers and extract mvpa4s / neurosurf4s
